page_template.$comment: Generated at load time from the slot model in klartex/page_templates.py (page_template_schema); see registry.py.

number_format.description: Number format for amounts: 'sv' gives 32 400,00 (default), 'en' gives 32,400.00.

logo.description: Image file (pdf/png) shown in the invoice body's top-left corner, aligned with the FAKTURA block. A plain file name is looked up via the asset directory (the page template's directory) and cwd.

logo_height.description: Logo height as a LaTeX dimension, e.g. '1cm'.

logo_offset.description: Fine-tunes the logo position, as fractions of its height: positive x moves right (negative left), positive y moves up (negative down). E.g. {"y": 0.25} when the artwork has built-in padding. Starting point: left edge at the margin, top edge aligned with the FAKTURA heading.

footer.description: The invoice footer: company, contact and payment details on every page. This is the canonical place for payment details — the standalone bankgiro/plusgiro/iban/bic fields are only a fallback and are suppressed when the footer carries payment details.

address.description: Postal address as an array with one line per element, e.g. ['Storgatan 1', '123 45 Stad'] — line-broken like a postal address. A string renders as a single line.

seat.description: Registered seat of the board, e.g. 'Malmö'

f_tax.description: true shows the line 'Godkänd för F-skatt' (approved for F-tax)

sender.description: Sender/seller — shown as its own block next to the recipient in the invoice body. Give the company's legal name here even when a logo/footer is present.

bankgiro.description: Fallback: payment details belong in the invoice's footer field. Use these fields only when no footer with payment details is configured — the in-body block is suppressed otherwise.
